title: Parambarai
desc: Paramasivan has a rocky relationship with his father following the tragic murder of his mother. To make matters more complicated, he falls in love with the daughter of a ruthless landlord.

title: Thayillamal Nannilai
desc: Raja falls in love with Bhuvana, the daughter of a landlord. However, the landlord agrees to their relationship only if Raja forsakes his mother.

title: Kasi
desc: Having endured years of blindness and the hardships that accompanied it, a visually impaired musician is tricked into believing that a physician can restore his sight.

title: Vellore Mavattam
desc: Muthukumar becomes an IPS officer and is posted in his own district. In spite of facing problems from the local politicians for being honest, he vows to change the corrupt system.

title: Thalai Nagaram
desc: After Right, a petty criminal, kills Bhai's son, Bhai's gangsters seek revenge by killing Right's friend Balu. Later, Right decides to lead a normal life, but a corrupt police officer exploits him.
